sections.value:
**Performance: pass-with-notes** at `65fc109ffc83dd4244aa6dd9f04a8ba1840d3ec5`. **P152-F004 is closed.**

Reviewed `d8bf337..65fc109`. `ownProcStart` stores only this runtime instance's own process birth stamp. Boot, correlated replies, controls and the other own-PID caller context use `selfProcStart`; the only reader invocation left is inside that synchronous getter. This is a lifetime-bound own-process value, not a generic cache of potentially recycled external PIDs, and it does not replace daemon-side liveness checks.

**Normal budget:** one existing ps observation at the first successful boot/read per OMP/Pi runtime instance, **zero additional process-start probes per subsequent send/control, zero per tick**. One numeric slot per runtime; no expiry timer, sweep or map. A failed initial observation throws without populating the cache, so a later retry can observe again; this is not a hard one-attempt failure cap. The legacy default startup ps helper is unchanged: this closes the newly repeated send path, not a claim that all runtime startup is launch-free.

Exact-head TS executes the new boot + correlated reply + control budget test: the reader seam receives only `[process.pid]`, and both messages keep the same caller procStart. Source inspection ties that one seam invocation to the unchanged default helper's one command. No local probe was needed.

**Other delta:** VerifiedPull and its ephemeral proof allocation are removed. Paneless correlated requests now refuse; shim subject verification and ordinary reply-resolver reads can still be paid before refusal. Pane-bound requests retain the existing registry/liveness path. The conditional closed-table lookup remains: only on an open-table miss, with full closed-row/body materialization. No new timer, automatic retry, authentication exchange or launch site.

The intentional paneless workaround is not cost-free: an uncorrelated delivery plus a separate `pij output --answers` can pay the existing output writer's store/git/ddocs/notification work in addition to delivery. It is explicit per-action work, not a new background loop. No new no-delivery answer path was introduced.

Prior recipient-scoped held queries, one shared terminal watcher, event-driven during-turn claims/15-second backstop, per-member retention and atomic answer/audit/publication-lock qualifications stand. Previously reviewed main changes are inherited.

**CI:** exact-head [42405277900](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42405277900) succeeds. Node 22 runs **114 rust-runtime tests**, including the cache budget and shared OMP wire contract; Vitest **2,248 passed/six skipped**. JUnit has **2,161 executed Rust cases, zero failures/errors**, including metadata-replay refusal/advice/uncorrelated control, closed-request gate, pane/OMP positives, atomic answer/audit and all six spawn guards. Latest Delivers **42405292351** succeeds at this SHA. F106 remains: fixture replay is not a live TS-to-daemon run.

No local build, test, mutation, runtime probe or worktree edit. Migration 0043 is unchanged. Security/reviewer own the full C32 and reply-compatibility verdict. After-deploy same-incarnation launches/CPU/RSS and legitimate reply/claim/SDK latency/rates remain owed.
